title: Composition of reaching and rejection
statement: Let $P$ be a register program with oracle, and let $c_0,c_1,c$ be configurations on the same input, with register $r$ and integer position $p$. If $c_0$ reaches $c_1$ relative to $c,r,p$, and the computation from $c_1$ rejects relative to $c,r,p$, then the computation from $c_0$ rejects relative to $c,r,p$.
hypotheses_covered: The computation from $c_1$ rejects relative to $c,r,p$
